title: eriophyton marrubioides
intro: Eriophyton marrubioides, commonly known as Himalayan Marrubium, is a perennial plant belonging to the family Lamiaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, including its health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues. The plant's therapeutic actions include its antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Eriophyton marrubioides include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential applications in traditional medicine.
